audit_type: author inspection of every initially derived preference pair
primary_failure: The blind evaluator recovered the correct GrammarCell but used free-form aliases for canonical operation labels, creating false exact-match rejections.
secondary_observation: One rejected item was genuinely answer-ambiguous, but it was not a wrong-target structural negative and v1 did not preregister quality-only preference labels.
action: Invalidated all initial pairs, repaired the evaluator ontology, retained pre-repair evidence, and reran validation before any model training.
interpretation: The candidate texts were plausible, but the supposed preference distinction was not real. They must not be released or used for training.
